sources.title: amgustav/forge-qwen2.5-3b-function-calling · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-3B Function Calling A fine-tuned version of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, trained to reliably call functions and operate as an AI agent — selecting the right API, formatting parameters correctly, and chaining multiple calls. What it does Give it a list of available tools and a user request, and it returns correctly formatted function calls.

sources.title: Function Calling and Tool Use | QwenLM/Qwen2.5 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Relevant source files This page explains how to use Qwen2.5's function calling and tool use capabilities, which allow the model to interact with external functions and tools. These capabilities enable Qwen2.5 to extend beyond text generation to perform actions like retrieving real-time information or executing calculations.

sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.
